cd /tmp/io-screening-v2-csv-qwen-D9U2wD && python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv
src = {}
with open('anc4_coverage.csv') as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        src[(r['district'], r['year'])] = (int(r['pregnancies_registered']), int(r['anc4_completed']))

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('gaya_nalanda_anc4_2021_vs_2023.csv')))
assert len(rows) == 2
for r in rows:
    d = r['district']
    reg21, c21 = src[(d, '2021')]; reg23, c23 = src[(d, '2023')]
    assert (int(r['registered_2021']), int(r['anc4_completed_2021'])) == (reg21, c21)
    assert (int(r['registered_2023']), int(r['anc4_completed_2023'])) == (reg23, c23)
    p21 = round(c21/reg21*100, 1); p23 = round(c23/reg23*100, 1)
    assert abs(float(r['coverage_2021_pct']) - p21) < 1e-9, (d, p21)
    assert abs(float(r['coverage_2023_pct']) - p23) < 1e-9, (d, p23)
    assert abs(float(r['change_2021_to_2023_pp']) - (p23 - p21)) < 1e-9
    print(f"{d:8s} 2021: {c21}/{reg21}={p21}%  2023: {c23}/{reg23}={p23}%  change: {p23-p21:+.1f} pp  OK")
print("CSV verified against source data")
EOF
